messages:
maria: Heads up — billing alert picked up a large inter-region egress spike this morning tied to model-artifacts. Roughly ~6TB/day eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 over last 24h. Anyone on snapshot/replication jobs?

billing-bot: [Auto] Alert: Cross-region egress exceeded threshold for project `redwood-models`. Top contributor: `snapshots/nightly/`. Estimated daily charge: $12.3k. Invoice: https://billing.example.com/invoices/INV-2026-03 :warning:

jay: :eyes: can you paste the billing query or prefix list? i'll grep storage logs and traces.

maria: pasted the top 5 prefixes from the billing query — `snapshots/nightly/` is 78% of the traffic, then `model-checkpoints/` and `logs/trace-exports/`. Noticed artifact-syncer jobs fired a couple of times this morning.

arjun: We rolled out artifact-syncer v1.2 last week to improve throughput. Default flags include `--region-source=eu-west-1` and `--region-target=us-west-2` if unset. Suspect a misconfig or a cron overlap caused full re-syncs. From controller logs: 

```
2026-03-18T03:58:12Z INFO starting sync job id=sync-20260318-01 prefix=snapshots/nightly/
2026-03-18T04:12:02Z INFO pushing object key=snapshots/nightly/2026-03-17/model-abc.tar.gz size=1.2GB attempt=1
2026-03-18T04:12:42Z INFO pushing object key=snapshots/nightly/2026-03-17/model-def.tar.gz size=1.4GB attempt=1
2026-03-18T04:13:10Z WARN retrying push id=sync-20260318-01 reason=timeout retry=true
```

arjun: those `retry=true` logs look like the controller retried lots of objects — could've multiplied effective egress.

sophia: Any idea on customer impact if we pause it? which services rely on that replica?

leo: It's primarily an analytics mirror and old nightly snapshots used for downstream training in us-west. Not serving live traffic. We can pause for 24h without user-facing impact.

ops-bot: Command suggestion to pause artifact-syncer in prod: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment artifact-syncer --replicas=0`

maria: pausing now, running that command. @ops-bot please confirm once scaled. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Executed: scaled deployment `artifact-syncer` (namespace=infra, deployment=artifact-syncer) to 0 replicas.

arjun: I'll open a hotfix to change the default flags and add a region-guard to avoid cross-region full-syncs unless explicitly approved. PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/artifact-syncer/pulls/128

jay: created ticket RED-4201 to capture cost impact, add quota, and follow-up action items: https://tickets.internal/RED-4201

billing-bot: Updated projection after pause: expected egress reduction ~5.9TB/day -> estimated savings ~$11.9k/day. Alert suppressed while remediation ongoing.

sophia: good catch. Let's document the replication policy and add an automated helm check for region flags. Also confirm lifecycle rules on the bucket to avoid accidental re-replication of older snapshots.

maria: assigning remediation to @arjun and @leo. I'll follow up with a one-pager for infra execs.

leo: :thumbsup: will scope a plan to switch to provider-managed replication (CRR) or configure regional-only mirrors where possible.

jay: will also add a billing dashboard card for `snapshots/nightly/` so we get per-prefix alerts.

maria: thanks all — i'll keep this thread updated with billing numbers and the postmortem notes.
